'''The Last Knight Challenge''' was a Spotlight Mission in September featuring a series of difficult battles with Cinematic Bots in celebration of the digital release of ''Transformers: The Last Knight''. 

*'''Date:''' 9/21~10/04
*'''Difficulties''': 4

== Rewards ==
*'''Act Completion Rewards:'''
**2-Star: 3 Premium Bot Crystals
**3-Star: T1 Alpha Spark
**4-Star: T2 Alpha Spark
*'''Act Exploration Rewards:'''
**2-Star: 3 T3 Basic Ore-13
**3-Star: 3 T4 Basic Ore-13
**4-Star: 1 T5 Basic Ore-13
